records.name: Innocence Cannon
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user fires a large expanding Ki projectile that travels forward and detonates on contact; current Xenoverse 2 evidence establishes the move as a Majin Buu mentor skill.

records.name: Justice Rush
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. A rushing multi-hit martial-arts sequence associated with Gohan (Adult) and Videl's mentor lessons; current provenance research identifies the mentor-training route as the Basic Reward.

records.name: Shining Friday
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. Fires a rapid sequence of Ki projectiles; current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Android 17 (DB Super) as the associated skill source.

records.name: Strike of Revelation
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. A close-range Whis technique that uses a rapid approach and striking sequence; current mentor research places it after Finishing Blow in Whis's training progression.

records.name: Sudden Storm
records.mechanics_notes: 200-Ki Ki Blast Super. Fires a rapid spread/sequence of Ki projectiles; the dedicated Xenoverse 2 evidence supports the corrected 200-Ki cost and Turles mentor acquisition.

records.name: Super Explosive Wave
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Evasive. The user releases a close-range explosive wave around them as an evasive attack; current repository research identifies Piccolo's older classification listing as an Evasive, while the canonical taxonomy should preserve the Evasive class.
